text:
olivia: quick heads-up: found a nastypath where scoped roles + per-route quotas confuse the console. users with routes.read see the quota card but backend returns 403 so UI shows 0/0 and support gets pinged. :confused:
marco: is this a UI visibility bug or the API contract?
olivia: both. frontend renders card (feature flag enabled) then fetch to /api/routes/:id/quota -> 403. frontend treats as missing data, not forbidden.
anya: what should product prefer: hide the card, or show read-only metrics with a CTA to request edit access?
sam: prefer read-only for enterprise tenants. We should avoid hiding metrics. Backend should return a clear signal so UI can render disabled controls rather than error.
marco: propose mapping scopes to access_level: when user has read only return 200 with {access_level:"read", quota:...}, when write return access_level:"write". when they truly lack visibility return 404. keep 403 for tenant-level blocks.
olivia: currently many calls return 403 empty. small additive contract change OK as long as we keep backward compat.
marco: authz middleware already exposes allowed_scopes. api-gateway can translate to access_level easily.
anya: UX: render metrics, disable edit controls, add "Request edit access" CTA that opens a tenant-admin modal. provide tooltip explaining why fields disabled.
sam: telemetry: emit event quota_card_rendered with access_level tag. sample authz traces 1% default, and allow full sampling per-tenant via feature flag. Also add authz_rule to sampled logs.
olivia: tests: add unit tests in authz and integration test that simulates old 403 -> new 200(access_level=read) so frontend behaves deterministically.
marco: i'll start backend patch today. small change. will include tests.
sam: i'll do console PR behind flag and pair with olivia on the modal CTA flow.
anya: rollout: backend first, console behind feature flag, 10% orgs for 48h, monitor telemetry + support tickets. add alert if quota_card_rendered:read vs write ratio deviates >10%.
olivia: will draft rollout checklist and update Console RBAC docs. i'll ping #release-war-room when ready.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary flip for feature/console-quota-access-level at 2025-11-02T09:00Z (cancelable within 15m).
